newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +4.52 pct vs mark/USD basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +4.52 pct vs mark/USD basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 27.823 to the dollar after Wednesday's fixing at 27.922, and at 16.955 to the mark from 16.894.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +4.52 percent, after a deviation of +4.62 on Wednesday.
During the minute at which the central bank calculated today's fixing, the crown was trading on the interbank market at +4.50 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT), and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
